Container.Name: sorttv-python
Container.Overview: SortTV (Python port): sorts TV episodes, movies and music from a downloads folder into an organised library, once a day at SORTTV_RUN_AT. Edit /config/sorttv.conf after the first start.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: sorttv.conf, sorttv.log and the lookup cache

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: One share holding downloads, tv, movies etc. (sorttv.conf uses /data/downloads, /data/tv, ...)

Config.Name: Run time
Config.Description: Sort once a day at this time (24-hour HH:MM). Leave empty to run once and stop.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for the run time

Config.Name: TheTVDB API key
Config.Description: Optional here: can be set in sorttv.conf instead

Config.Name: TMDb API key
Config.Description: Optional here: can be set in sorttv.conf instead
